entry.title: BC time zone change for UBCIT managed Windows OS devices October 20, 2026, 16:00 PT.
entry.content:
Oct 21, 16:01 PDT
Completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.

Oct 20, 16:00 PDT
In progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

Oct 20, 14:04 PDT
Scheduled - UBC IT managed PCs will be targeted with a silent package that will transition Windows OS to the new BC time zone (UTC-07:00) Pacific Time (British Columbia). For Windows OS PCs that have Location Services and Set time zone automatically turned on, the time zone change will be controlled by the OS. For all other scenarios the silent package will take care of setting the time zone to (UTC-07:00) Pacific Time (British Columbia), or (UTC-07:00) Yukon, depending on the availability of the new time zone to the OS which was made available via the Oct 13, 2026 Windows Cumulative Security Updates. We realize this may impact a small number of devices operating outside BC (Washington, Oregon, California) that may need to be corrected after this change.

entry.title: UBC websites and web services may be temporarily unavailable
entry.content:
Oct 21, 17:17 PDT
Update - We are continuing to apply security updates to affected websites and web applications. Some of these web based services may remain unavailable or experience connection issues while IT teams complete security updates. Please note that some websites and web applications may only be available on campus or through UBC VPN until further notice.

Thank you for your patience as we work to restore all services.

The next update will be tomorrow, October 22 at 12:30 PM.

Oct 21, 12:52 PDT
Update - We are continuing to monitor and patch impacted websites and applications. Users may still experience issues connecting to some websites or applications. Thank you for your patience as we work to restore all services.

The following services have been patched and are now fully available:

• Canvas
• Websites on CMS
• UBC Blogs
• H5P
• Moodle
• iPeer
• UBC Wiki
• Card Scanner

The next update will be at 4:30 PM.

Oct 21, 11:11 PDT
Investigating - UBC is responding to a global critical issue affecting technology used by some websites and web applications.

As a precaution, some UBC websites or services may be temporarily unavailable from off-campus while they are assessed and security updates are applied. If a website you are trying to access is unavailable, this may be the reason.

UBC IT and distributed IT teams are working to identify affected systems and restore any impacted services as soon as they can be safely returned to operation.

No action is required from users at this time.

We will be providing updates on a regular basis regarding this issue.

In progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

Scheduled - UBC ARC Sockeye will be unavailable on Tuesday, October 20 from 09:00 until 18:00 PT for scheduled maintenance.

User Impact:

1. During this time, you will be unable to log in or transfer data to/from Sockeye, OnDemand, and Chinook.

2. All jobs will be queued. The scheduler will not start any job if its requested walltime overlaps with the
maintenance window, even if resources are available. Only jobs expected to finish before downtime
begins will be scheduled, if resources allow.

3. In rare cases, running jobs may need to be resubmitted. Please checkpoint or complete your jobs before
the maintenance window to avoid lost progress, and check your job queue afterward.
